name: Leonidas HPM (Epirus)
description: Software-defined high-power microwave array; defeats swarms in a sector. ~1 km planning value, 120 deg beam.

pk.condition: 0.7 (PF); 61 of 61 drones disabled, 49-drone swarm in one pulse (counts outside their trial domain, so no spread)
pk.source: Epirus press release, 10 Sep 2025 (epirusinc.com, "Leonidas high power microwave defeats 49-drone swarm")

fieldStrengthVm.note: Epirus publishes no field strength, no radiated power and no range for Leonidas; the product page carries qualitative claims only. Not established by the public record.

fieldStrengthRangeM.note: The reference range for a field strength that is not published. Not established by the public record.

beamwidthDeg.note: Planning factor: Epirus publishes no antenna pattern. The 120 deg sector placard in this file is taken as the half-power beamwidth, which is the widest reading and matches the counter-swarm use of a wide illuminated volume.

rechargeS.note: Planning factor: a solid-state GaN array has no capacitor charging cycle, and Epirus advertises repeated fire with no reload, so the gap between shots is a duty-cycle limit rather than a recharge. 1 s is the planning value; no figure is published.
